title: Trump opposes robust AI regulation, says it would stifle super intelligence development
summary: President Donald Trump warned that any “robust” regulation of artificial intelligence, or super intelligence as he terms it, would “stifle” development — even as the US imposes new restrictions on access to advanced AI technology. In remarks to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday, Trump said AI is “almost completely good, but it’s got some bad elements, and we have to be very careful in managing those bad elements. But “we oppose any form of robust regulation or anything to control and stifle SI, and we won’t allow that to happen, frankly,” he told foreign leaders in the plenary session, using his preferred term for super intelligence.
